Tooltip_HARMONIE_WarmingSpicedBitters: A fiery spiced tonic meant to get the blood moving. <LINE> Eases the worst of the cold, but true warmth still has to come from a fire and dry clothes.
Tooltip_HARMONIE_WillowBarkAntitoxinBoos: A bitter herbal preparation, thought to help the body fight off lockjaw alongside proper antitoxin. <LINE> Not a substitute for real medicine, but every little bit helps.
